in_marathi.name: Thiyagu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of War
in_marathi.long_meaning: Thiyagu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Thiyagu is a name of the Tamil God Murugan, who is considered the God of War, Kama Sutra, and Love. He is also known as Subrahmanyam or Shanmukha.
